title: Charge, current and drift
design_rationale: Build the carrier model, charge transfer and quantisation before the microscopic drift-current equation.
concepts_taught: understand that an electric current is a flow of charge carriers
understand that the charge on charge carriers is quantised
use, for a current-carrying conductor, the expression I = Anvq, where n is the number density of charge carriers

next_module_can_assume: understand that an electric current is a flow of charge carriers
understand that the charge on charge carriers is quantised
use, for a current-carrying conductor, the expression I = Anvq, where n is the number density of charge carriers
next_module_must_not_assume: define the potential difference across a component as the energy transferred per unit charge
